title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and state the final answer as (a).

title: Understanding of Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The response should demonstrate an understanding of conservation of momentum in the context of the problem.

title: Explanation of Helicity
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide reasoning regarding helicity and its implications in elastic collisions.

title: Spherical Symmetry Insight
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss the implications of angular distribution in elastic collisions.

title: Common Misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid misinterpreting the conditions of the collision, such as assuming non-planar trajectories.
